entries.text: Abel is a chubby, stocky man with a dark brown quiff, greenish eyes, a beard and mustache, and a brown country hat with tableware on it. He has a leather jacket with wood-patterned designs, with some tables on top, a sewn-in flower vase, and on his shoulders are two tables with porcelain cups and tea-cups, in addition to wearing a white and gray striped dress shirt. On the bottom, he wears brown jeans with a gray upper center part, and a gray belt with a rectangular buckle with symbols of a knife, a plate, and a fork, as well as a pair of chaps and a dress shoe. In addition, he has some tattoos on his left arm, and has a large amount of hair growing on his arms and chest.

Airyn takes the form of a thin woman who appears translucent and outlined with a light pink glow. Her irises and lips are light pink, but she still has the whites of her eyes which are not transparent. Her hair, a translucent pink, is gently blown upwards and appears slightly curled at the end. She has a dress made of wind that curls around her upper bicep to create off-the-shoulder sleeves. It also swirls around her body in a spiral that covers her chest, parts of her stomach, her crotch, her knees, and then swirls upward to create a trim. She has no other accessories, including shoes.

Amir is a tall, somewhat muscular man with long wavy black hair and well-defined thick eyebrows, gray eyes, and clear brown skin. He has facial hair consisting of a mustache, soul patch, and slight beard. He wears flashy, silver clothing that is transparent in some parts. The narrator describes him as a long-haired beauty who looks at you like you're a work of art.

Arma has tanned skin and hair resembling smoke plumes. Her outfit is a firefighter's bunker gear which consists of a red alarm-shaped helmet, a white-coloured suit with a fire-detector badge on her left, black-coloured gloves and boots, finished with white and gold stripes. Her suit is unbuttoned, revealing a red top; there are fire and battery symbols next to the buttons. A hose wraps around her shoulders and waist which mimics wires. She carries an air horn with her.

Artt is a lean, genial older man whose pale white skin and statuesque figure suggest that he is literally made of marble. He has a full head of short-cropped, coiled white hair and a large beard of the same, as well as a thick chevron mustache protruding from beneath his nose, where a pair of picture-frame glasses sits. His impressive body is left completely nude save for a practiced strand of ivy growing along his hips and chest, tastefully obscuring his groin. Strung across his right shoulder is a toga-like cloak of fabric that hangs down to a marble stand on which his feet appear to be attached. Stuck to the side of this stand is a price-tag, divulging that Artt was $10.01.

Barry is a tall, lean man with light pink hair shaped to resemble classical lipstick. He is clean-shaven with light brown/hazel eyes. Despite his hairstyle, he does not appear to be wearing any lipstick, however, he has rings of different colored makeup swatches on his arms ranging from light browns, dark browns, purples, and blues. He also has gold nail polish on his short nails. Barry is wearing multicolored flip-up glasses; the right lens has orange and light brown coloring, while the left lens has light and dark greens. He has a golden headband tied around his forehead that resembles a lipstick container. He has an opened quilted short-sleeve jacket that reveals a black fishnet layer underneath. The outside is a dark blue, while the inside is cream-colored with light brown hearts that follow the points of the quilting. His open collar is lined with pink and white makeup brushes, with larger ones on the outside and smaller ones leading inwards. His sleeves are made of fur that is darker closer to the shoulder and lighter further out. The jacket has two rows of eye shadows that loop around the entire jacket horizontally. He has matching trousers that are quilted and black, and an ankle length open skirt with the same patterning, colors, and quilting as his jacket. He also has heeled quilted dress shoes with open eye shadow containers with mirrors that flip upwards.

Bathsheba has silver eyes, brown skin, and curly black hair that is tied in an updo, with a golden handheld shower head as her headband. Subtle bubbles float around her head. She wears minimal makeup and earrings made of two distinct bath bombs, a purple and blue mix on the left and a pink and white mix on the right. She has black medium almond acrylic nails with gold French tips. Her porcelain-textured one-piece features gold pipes as the straps, with the hot water knob on her right shoulder and the cold water knob on her left. Around her neck, she wears a golden faucet as a choker, along with a necklace resembling a drain plug. Her black robe matches the outside of the tub, with a white inner lining, bubbles for the trim, and a golden matching belt tied in a bow. Her golden slippers resemble the foot of the tub.

Beau has brown eyes, curly brown hair tied back in a ponytail, is wearing minimal, if any, makeup, and has a peach-like skin tone. All the clothes she is wearing consist of cardboard and several kinds of tape. She wears a dark brown cropped cardboard jacket with brown packing tape finishings and the cuffs rolled up to her elbows. She also has a bucket hat with a wide brim, has clear packing tape finishings, and a light to dark gradient from the top. Beau also wears a white shirt with a V-neckline with orange trim held together by duct tape. Around her waist, she wears a belt made of duct tape, with a slim roll of duct tape that holds a power strip attached to an extension cord which she uses as a rope. Her pants are made of light brown cardboard held together by clear packing tape. Across her body hangs a sling bag on her left shoulder made of a white and blue pizza box with duct tape for the cross-body strap. She has brown knee-high boots with a short heel and turnover flaps that are also held together by brown packing tape.

Ben-hwa has warm-toned skin, brown eyes, and eyeliner and light blue eyeshadow on their eyes. Their hair is made of standard and tentacle dildos. They are wearing a sheer, striped jumpsuit, that mimics the pattern of the bag they are in, a shawl, and no shoes. Over the jumpsuit, they are wearing a strap-on belt. Their shawl is comprised of dildos, rabbit vibrators, feathers, and a butt plug on their right shoulder. There is a large pink rose on their left shoulder that is also surrounded by darker pink petals. They are wearing black handcuffs lined with pink fuzzy material on both wrists that are connected by a chain. They are wearing earrings that resemble eggplants, their left earring rather small and their right earring rather long. They are wearing a pink ball gag with a leather strap as well as a string of anal beads around their neck.

Betty has a curvy frame, curly pink hair, and dark eyes with minimal makeup. Her fair skin is marked with freckles across her arms and clavicle. She has medium almond nails that are peach colored. She wears a headband made of the throw pillows that appear on the bed. She wears the comforter of the bed as a floor length robe with large, puffy sleeves and a pillow acting as a cuff behind her head. Over the robe is a bustier that resembles the hardware of the bed as the straps, the headboard covering her chest, and the torso making up the slats on the bed. She wears capri leggings that are tufted on the front and grey on the sides, mimicking the design of a mattress. She wears open-toed heels with pillow fluff decorating the strap and mattress springs for the heel. Her toenails are painted the same blue as the pillows.

She has a thin physique, with fair skin and ginger hair that has a drink-like appearance. Her hair is long, in the shape of a ponytail, curled with two straws at the top in a descending direction, forming a spiral, using an umbrella with an olive on her head, and two leaves attached behind her ear, plus a cherry earring. For clothing, she wears a kind of apron with the buster part resembling a juice box, and around her neck a bow with a golden pendant in the central part. On her abdomen, there is a decoration of two cabinets on each side, each one having drinks on display, and further down a tea bag tied with a rope that passes through her waist, serving as an apron; next to it a green sign with the symbol of tea, and finally her skirt that goes up to the knees, with an ice print surrounding it and a salt rim on the hemline. On each forearm, she holds two mugs of beer, and on each wrist she uses vodka shot glasses, one with a slice of lemon and the other a slice of lime.

Bobby is a person with tan skin and brown eyes. Their design consists of hairclips throughout their body. Their brown, curly hair is side shaved, clipped with bobby pins on the shaved part, and they have an earring in the design of a bobby pin. They wear a black leather jacket with bobby pins at the bottom of the jacket and the upper arms, two pockets, a popped up collar, and a yellow zipper. They have black leather pants with holes on the legs, as well as some more bobby pins. The shoes are short heeled black boots with the laces resembling pins as well.

Bodhi is a young, well-muscled and clean-shaven man with a head of dense curls resembling cassette tapes, which fall over his eyes. He sports a full body of 80's memorabilia and nostalgic references, including small cassette tapes throughout his hair and a cassette player attached to the jacket sleeve, Lite-Brites and two floppy disks on the front of his jacket, two velvet scrunchies around his right wrist and Rubik's-cube themed bracelets on his left, light blue dolphin shorts with white racer stripes, a pair of retro foam headphones around his waist, clear jelly shoes, and various tattoos (Memphis Patterns on his left arm, a heart with a Blockbuster ticket on the right, and two retro rainbows on his legs). The narrator describes him as nostalgia given form.

Cabrizzio has tan skin, light green eyes, stubble across his jaw, and black shiny hair. His sleeveless shirt has a plunging neckline and is patterned with dishes and silverware with marble-textured trims. His jacket, which is cut above the elbows, has a wooden look. It is decorated with cabinet hinges, handles, doors, white brick details, and his shoulders as countertops. His dark grey pants follow a pattern of silver knobs, cabinet doors, and drawers throughout with a little light grey trim. His shoes' design are similar to his jacket, the front being a marble countertop, a cabinet drawer with a handle, and the shoe collar having a white trim.

Cam has medium-length wavy brown hair and a slight facial stubble. He wears a white bucket hat that is actually an overturned takeaway container with a banana peel on top. He has a white grocery bag for a tank top, an oversized jacket that is simply a black trash bag, and plastic strips and other scraps as accessories. His footwear are a pair of silver-colored trashcans.

Jacques Pierrot is a stout, scruffy man with shoulder-length brown hair. His outfit resembles that of a typical pop culture pirate, assembled from various knickknacks, including mismatched buttons, a white, plastic bread tie on his belt, a thimble on top of a bottlecap for a hat, and a bright pink plastic sword cocktail pick and a green thumbtack as weapons. There is also a living toy chick on his shoulder bearing an eyepatch. He is missing his right leg, which has been replaced by a screw in place of a peg leg. He has nuts on his wrists, resembling bracelets or cuffs and brown gloves.

Celia Stipple is a tall woman of seemingly European descent, with platinum blonde hair pulled into a finger-wave updo with coiffed bangs and a white hair snood. She wears a white, form-fitting, knee-length dress featuring designs based on the look of crown molding and circular lights. She also wears a cape with similar designs on it. Her accessories include silver earrings shaped like chandeliers, a white rosette pinned to her dress, a large ring with a pearl or similar white precious item in it, and a pair of white heels.

Chairemi has short platinum blonde hair, fair skin, and wears simple makeup with long eyelashes. While Chairemi's appearance changes by the day and the show she is performing, she does have a default outfit. Her default outfit consists of a green, patterned tube top that connects to a high neck collar that resembles the back and arms of a dining chair. The bottom of the tube top connects to the stem of a rolling chair that rests above a skirt made of chair cushions. She wears brown plaid leggings with chair shaped thigh cuffs that match the arm cuffs she wears. She wears white socks with Mary Janes that resemble a chair, with the legs of the chair acting as heels and the back of the chair by her calf.

Chance is a person with red eyes, red-lensed and gold-rimmed glasses, and brown hair. Occasionally cloaked in a TTRPG map with figures adorned. The underside of the neck of his cape are character sheets. When the cloak is removed, a shirt with a drawn map on grid paper is visible. The hood of the shirt is a D20 and the neck piece of the same shirt is another D20. On the right wrist is an assortment of many dice used in TTRPGs as bracelets, and the underside of the wrist is a tattoo of a dragon with at its horns another D20. The left wrist has a multicolored gem bracelet. The chest piece is a red rules book for G&G and the pants are a black pair of shorts resembling a drawstring dice bag, patterned with golden swords, shields, and dragons. The shoes are red and black with gold accents.

Connie has a fair complexion with rosy cheeks and black medium-length hair with blonde highlights. She wears yellow eyeshadow that matches her star-shaped pupils. Floating on the sides of and above her head is a large video game controller, split into three. Her dress accentuates her slim figure, with a shooting star design in the center and stripes on the sides. Her sleeves represent the console with disks sticking out of them. She wears black pinstripe gloves with rectangular bracelets over them, similar to her sleeves. On her backside hang two cords, resembling tails. She also has bulky boots resembling controllers. The bottoms of her shoulders, bracelets, and boots glow yellow.

Curt is a dark-skinned man with short, curly black hair. His sleeveless top is patterned with gold diamond shapes on black fabric, held together by a series of vertical gold fastenings resembling curtain hooks. Curt's arms are adorned with sky blue sleeve pieces that connect to a flowing curtain half-cape on each side, attached by decorative loops on his upper arms. He wears fitted white pants with a sheer overskirt resembling curtain panels. Gold chain accents are present at his waist and ankles. His shoes are dark blue with teal panels and gold soles. Rod is a lean, dark-skinned man with short, twisted dreadlocks and sharp, narrow eyes. He wears a deep red curtain drape across his chest, held in place by a row of metallic rings pierced through a thick curtain rod resting on his shoulders. Rod's tunic is patterned in beige and white lines and held together in the front by a black vertical column of rigid bars with curtain hooks. His sleeves are short, each cuffed with large silver rings. Around his neck is a short white curtain fragment. Rod wears black pants covered in gold diamond patterns, tucked above the ankles. Around his waist is a thick, gold braided rope with tasseled ends. His shoes are flat, black and white with silver straps and red fabric around the ankles, gathered by gold rings. Gold bangles cover his wrists and forearms.

Daemon is a slim, broad-shouldered figure whose appearance is marked by glitches, featuring two distorted error pop-ups. The jacket hints at an old character model (deep-fried in quality), except for a purple and black checkered collar indicating missing textures. The torso displays a red-to-black gradient with occasional dead pixels. Daemon has black hair, blue eyes, and pointed ears.

Daisuke is a tall man with shoulder-length black hair and black eyes. He is wearing blue dishware-themed umanori hakama with a kimono-style top, traditional Japanese sandals (seemingly ceramic rather than wooden), and a teacup tying some of his hair up in a bun. He has lightly tanned skin and sparse freckles adorning his whole body.

Dante is a sturdy, younger man with a bright appearance. His pompadour 'hair' is represented by a burning log, with the back covered by another log carved into a beanie shape. His upper body is engulfed in flames, with a bright orange heart at the centre, his legs presenting as hot coals that hold the flames up. He wears a sharp jacket made of light and dark grey brick, with wide shoulders in the shape of a fireplace mantel, with flat shoulders holding up memorabilia, including family pictures and Captain Jaqcues Pierrot's ship in a bottle. The bottom of the jacket and sleeves are fit with a cream skirting board. His shoes are a brown wooden material, with the laces also being made of flames. His socks have the same pattern as the trim of his jacket.

Dasha is a burly, pale skinned woman of muscular build. She has short layered hair, bluish-gray with a grayish-white ombre. Her outfit consists of a cropped jacket with shoulder and arm pads that mimic parts of the desk, long black pants, and boots that resemble drawers.

Diana is a slim and young looking woman with soft features. She has light blue eyes, outlined by dark eyeliner and subtle freckles across her cheeks. Her hair is light brown and coiled, pulled up into a messy bun with individual strands on either side of her face and a fringe over the right side of her face (obscured by her hat). Her outfit is quite chaotic, mostly made up of pale blue diary covers with gold accents, various torn out pages with scribbled writing in different ink colours and gold lockets. Her hat resembles a 'Mad Hatter' hat with diary pages and pens held into the band. She has a neck bow on the left of her face made up of folded diary pages, her jacket is similar to a waist coat with a diary folded over her shoulder on the left and crumpled up pages used as a sleeve on her right, the jacket has two belt straps across her chest both held in place by a gold heart lock. She has pages folded around her wrists resembling fingerless gloves, with a key on a chain wrapped around the left wrist. Her asymmetrical skirt is made up of scribbled diary pages lapped over one another, she has knee length socks made of pages and blue shoes.

Dirk appears to be tall and fit, with most of his body covered by dirty laundry. He has a sharp jaw with a head of disheveled dark brown, almost black hair, his eyes slightly lighter in color. He has a 'Do not bleach' symbol tattooed on his neck, and 4 symbols down his right arm: 'iron', 'machine wash delicate', 'tumble dry medium heat' and 'do not dry clean'. He is covered from the neck downwards in various dirty clothes, including a cream dirty towel, various colored plaid shirts, a suit jacket, a jean jacket, a pink button up, a black vest, a black pleated skirt with white accents, brown and red trousers, a blue scarf, dirty underwear and 3 pairs of socks.

Dishy appears as a light grey, standard dishwasher held up by a pair of toned human legs. He has a cartoon-ish expression with dark eye sockets, off-white pupils and a large toothy grin. He has a cream tea towel hung over his handle and two darker grey arms protruding from his sides, with large white gloves and two pipes attached to his backside. He wears metal barred shoes, resembling a dish-rack, with rollers on the underside.

Dolly has a playful, classic appearance with the black, strapless bunny suit accentuated with fluffy trims; her outfit includes a white collar and black necktie. Her shoes are black heels adorned with embellishments that match her outfit's trims. On her head is a black headband with tall, bunny ears with pink inner linings, and a gray tail in the back. Her hair and areas of her legs have debris tangled in it. Her nails are also done in a sharp-shape and a gray-color. Her hair is voluminous and curly, styled in a high ponytail cascading in thick, silver-gray curls. She has a curvy build and medium-skin tone, and up-close there are specks patterned all over her skin and body. She has full, dark eyebrows and eyes with a dark-gray color.

Dorian's primary appearance depicts him in a black suit with brown trim. The lapels and edges of the suit jacket mimic the filigree that can be found on door frames. The pockets on his jacket resemble a mail slot. He wears a white dress shirt with a door design with a single button at the top that looks like a door security camera. His belt also resembles a door frame but the buckle is a swing bar lock that is commonly used on doors. His shoes are black dress shoes with brown details. The tops of the shoes have designs that look like doors and the bottom edge and heel have brown detailing similar to the design on his lapels. He sports an armband on his left arm with a security system keypad. He wears an earring that resembles a chain lock that connects to a helix piercing on his right ear. He wears three necklaces, all with key shaped pendants; one is gold and two are silver. He wears a bracelet with a brass doorknob on it that looks like a watch. Dorian has tattoos on his forearms that are themed around doors, keys, and keyholes.

Doug is a white skinned humanoid dateable with a spherical head. His face is simple, two dots representing eyes and a thin line for a mouth. He is shirtless, wearing only ripped, form fitting jeans with pink underwear. He does not wear shoes or socks, or other clothes or accessories and is very muscular.

Drysdale is a muscular, tan man with medium-length, brown, greying hair. He wears an open, fluffy white shirt with black, metallic suspenders. His collar and shoulder have a material similar to dryer sheets, and atop his shoulders are knobs: two on the left, and one on the right. The ends of his sleeves resemble baffles, and on the left sleeve appears to be a lint trap. On his abdomen is an orange, translucent dryer door, exposing his abs. A striped red sock and a green sock stick out above the door, while a blue sock hangs below it. There is also a red sock in his left suspender. He wears orange pants with a white sock and a grey sock clung onto them. He has a silver belt resembling the inside of a dryer drum along with a heat outlet and lint screen/air inlet grille, as well as black loafers that fade to orange at the sole and have knobs on the front. Scattered on his body is loose lint.

Dunk has teak colored skin, an athletic build, brown eyes, and black stubble on his face. His hair is made of athletic gloves on top of his head. He wears eye black under his eyes. He wears American football pads that are made up of American footballs on the arms, a baseball on his right shoulder and a football/soccer ball on his left shoulder. He does not wear a shirt but his torso has white paint that resemble the lines on a basketball. He has two in-line skates on his elbows and sweat bands on his wrists. His pants are similar to ones worn in American football with a hockey rink design on them and badminton rackets on either hip. He wears knee pads that resemble a badminton shuttlecock with the feathers on his thighs. He wears untied football/soccer cleats and slouchy, discolored, crew socks.

Eddie has short, shaggy hair that is made up of black, grey, red, and brown wires. His face has a bit of stubble and eyebrows in a zig zag shape. He wears a vest, dress shirt, dress pants, and loafers. His dress shirt seems to be made of the same metal as the breaker box and is adorned with black, brown, orange, and white wires. His sleeves are rolled up just below the elbow and the cuffs are designed like sockets. His vest is made up of breaker box switches and is adorned with a wire that goes around the front of the vest and connects on both sides at the belt buckle. The same orange wiring also acts as a necklace. He wears calf-high boots that are black with a power strip acting as the tongue of the boot. Volt has shoulder-length, white hair that seems to be made entirely of electricity and goes into a zig zag on his side burns. He wears smudged black eyeliner and very sharp eyebrows with slight lightning bolt imagery at the ends. Volt is a fit man with a blush-tone skin and a slight orange tint. He has an oversized suit jacket draped on his shoulders. The jacket is a blue-green that matches the color of the breaker box in the house. The shoulders and lapels of the jacket have power strips that are connected by cords plugged into each socket and the lining of the jacket resembles instructions and warnings often found on breaker boxes. There is also a patch on one shoulder that resembles a caution sign. His vest resembles a fuse box and switches and that pattern continues on the sides of his black dress pants. He has black shoes with a golden accent detail that resembles a power switch. On his wrists there are bracelet cuffs that resemble copper wiring.

Her object appears as a tall black standing fan in the Home Gym. Her Dateable appears with a tall slender build and a darker skin complexion. She has a metal cord around her waist with a plug that resembles a belt, which also goes over her shoulders. Wearing black and white bell-bottoms, she also covers herself in many stickers both around her face and her clothing. Some stickers are hearts and stars, but one is a thumbs up saying "1" in a heart, as she is your number one fan. She has pink lipstick and eyeshadow on along with blush for her makeup. Her eyes are black but, when examined closely, appear to have blades resembling a ceiling fan. She also sports short bangs, but the rest of her hair is in the shape of fan blades which are encased in a golden fan, decorated with pink ribbons.

Farya wears minimal makeup with a tiny eyeliner wing. She wears a hijab made of elastic bandage held together with aluminum bandage clips. Her jacket is made of a first aid case with the black handle of the bag acting as her collar. The body of the jacket is zipped at the top, is belted with elastic bandage in the middle, and is open at the bottom. The bottom flaps of her jacket have clear pockets that hold gauze, a thermometer, ointments and creams, and bandages. She wears long sleeves that go down to her wrists that are made of silver mylar and holds a clipboard that is made of an adhesive bandage and uses an Epipen as her pen. She wears baggy silver mylar pants that go into her boots. Her boots are made of the same red and black material as her jacket and have bandages on the heel and the toe. The ties of the boot are represented by butterfly bandages.

Florence has amber eyes, short black hair, subtle freckles on her cheeks, and tan skin. She wears a white square-pattern drape cardigan in shades of teal, with pink and teal crossing lines, thin tassels lining the trim, and a carpet's backing layer as the inner lining. Her brown high-waisted skirt resembles wooden floorboards with shoe stains, paired with a grey brick-tiled pattern top that matches her cuff bracelets and features a fancy drainage-resembling design in the center. She also wears simple black tights and light grey tile-patterned heels.

Freddy is a towering, broad creature with features commonly found in many folklore yeti depictions. His skin is ice blue, with pale yellow eyeballs and black pupils, and he has a wide toothy grin with a slight underbite. Freddy has sharp dark black claws on both hands. He has dark cyan, shoulder length, wavy hair, with full mutton chops, a pointed beard and thick eyebrows of the same colour. He wears a long cyan coat resembling fridge doors and freezer drawers on the bottom half; there is an ice dispenser on the right jacket sleeve. The collar and sleeves are wrapped in light blue icicle shards, looking similar to fur. His top has fridge shelves with various food items across each layer, his bottoms are baggy and white, with an ice pack pattern across them and basket shelves across his knees. His boots are the same design as his coat, with small doors and freezer drawers on the front and a freezing symbol on the side.

Friar Errol is a somewhat slim pale, white man with no hair and teal eyes. Instead of hair, he has a black spiral-shape on his head resembling either a cord or a strainer of an air fryer. He has a black stubbled pencil mustache and a black goatee. He has very thin angular eyebrows. He wears black vestments that resemble those of a Roman Catholic monk with metal accents that contain various parts of an air fryer, namely the handle, strainer, control buttons, complete with a belt with more buttons on it. He carries a book with gold binding that has pictures noting an air fryer's settings such as the power, temperature, cooling system, and fan, in addition to buttons that have pictures of food on them.

Gaia is a petite, curvy, eager-eyed adventurer. She has wide eyes, a bright smile and freckles across her cheeks. She is a redhead with a shoulder length bob and a side swept fringe, a pair of golden goggles atop her head. There is a globe arm connecting from her left shoulder that attaches to the top of her head, with measurements along the front of it. She wears a brightly coloured necktie, which appears to have countries of the world on it in different colours. Her top is made up of blue graph paper with white lines drawn across, and her sleeves are similar to a brown bomber jacket with retro country and travel patches attached. Her pants are tight brown leather and she wears knee high golden boots. There are measuring tapes used as accents across her outfit, notably used as a belt, on the neckline and seams of her top. She also has the Canadian maple leaf attached to her pants zipper.

Hank 1 has a jumpsuit in a mix of orange and blue colors. He appears to be of African-American descent, his skin being a deep brown color and his hair twisted in locs. Hank 2 has a jumpsuit in a mix of red and green colors. He appears to be of East-Asian descent, his skin a warm ivory tone and his black eyes upturned and monolid. His hair is a dark black. Hank 3 wears a blue jumpsuit with wooden pants-hangers around the body. He appears to be of Irish descent; his hair is a light coppery ginger color. He has a chin-strap style beard and a light mustache, light freckles on his nose and cheeks. His eyes are a greenish-gray color. Hank 4 has a jumpsuit in a mix of purple and orange colors. He appears to be of White-American / European descent, his skin lightly tanned from being in the sun. He has curly blonde hair and has a missing canine tooth on his left side. He has greenish-brown eyes and thin brown eyebrows. Hank 5 wears a jumpsuit with green and white colors and pink plastic hangers around the body. He appears to be of Middle-Eastern / South-Asian descent, his skin a cool-toned toasted brown color. His black boots have pink lining in front and green plastic hangers design on each side. He has chocolate brown hair and brown eyes. He has a small mole on his right cheek and doesn't have any facial hair.

Harper is a thin woman with light skin and green eyes. She has freckles and slightly rosy cheeks. Her hair is red, wavy, and armpit-length, and is underneath a woven hamper lid that is worn as a hat. She wears a long sleeve tank top of the material of a woven hamper with the top part made of cloth and having a cloth bow in the center, resembling the inside of a hamper. The bottom is made of the same material as the rim of a woven hamper. Her skirt is much the same, having similar material with the part at the top having what resemble hamper handles. She wears knee length socks with bows and block heels, both of the same material as the rest of her outfit. On her back she has a hamper harnessed onto her, overflowing with clothing similar to what Dirk wears. She also always carries some of the clothing in her hands. Around her neck is a necklace resembling hung up clothing.

Hector's initial appearance is that of a simplistic, if not somewhat ominous, pair of dark eyes hidden within the shadowy confines of a ventilation shaft. He can often be seen with his hands, which are colored a warm brown, slipping out from between the bars.

Henry Hoove is wearing a fitted, white torso-piece that highlights his muscular shape. It's also paired with red armored segments on his shoulders, forearms, and lower legs. His pants are a bright red color with black, ribbed sections on the inner thighs and behind the knees. He's also sporting heavy-duty boots with white accents and thick soles. The side of his thighs have a gray, circular shape on top of the red armor, sticking outwards. His accessories include a utility belt holstered with tools, a coiled hose attached at the hip, and cords covered in debris wrapped around his gloves. In his physical appearance, he has a deep brown complexion with medium-to-long black dreadlocks styled into a half-up bun with the remainder flowing down with an undercut. His eyes are a red shade. He has a noticeably broad-shouldered physique, with strong arms and a defined chest. On his chin is facial hair, specifically a goatee, and his ears have silver piercings.

Hero-Hime's design is notably distinct from most other characters due to her anime art style. She has a thin build with light skin and prominent blue eyes. Her pink hair is styled in long pigtails with tennis balls positioned on top in an odango fashion. Her outfit consists of a pink dress featuring white accents and a lime green top. The dress includes puffy sleeves with white cuffs and a white ruffle at the hem, with white lines forming a tennis court pattern. A large white bow fading to hot pink secures the dress, with the bow's band resembling a tennis net. She wears a green headband with a white stripe and pink heart centerpiece. Around her neck hangs a yellow star-shaped medal on a white ribbon with a pink stripe. Her footwear includes white socks with cat ears and lime green sneakers featuring white soles, pink tongues, and decorative hearts and wings.

Holly is a young woman with walnut brown hair tied into two long curly pigtails, adorned with various holiday decorations. She has brown eyes, two-toned green and pink eyeshadow, and rosy pink lips. On her head is a white bunny-eared headband, reminiscent of the Easter Bunny. She also has four-leaf clovers on the right side of her head, evoking St. Patrick's Day. The decorations around her curly pigtails include Christmas lights, Christmas balls, Easter eggs of varying designs, as well as plastic bats reminiscent of Halloween. The earring on her left ear resembles Chinese firecrackers, while the earring on her right ear resembles a Chinese hanging lantern, both symbolic of the Lunar New Year festival. A white skeleton decoration dangles from Holly's right shoulder, mimicking her expressions and poses. Her jacket is a collared cropped tan piece, worn open to reveal layered, clashing patterns on her torso. She wears a bright pink dress underneath, undergoing a gradient from light pink at the top to neon pink near the bottom. The hem of the dress is frilled with light and dark pink ruffles, resembling crumpled paper. Her chest is adorned with purple, yellow, and blue patches, depicting hearts and a house, in a similar fashion to banners. Around her neck, she sports enormous, bubble-like blue beads. On her left hand, she wears a snowflake ring and a black and orange beaded bracelet. On her right hand, she wears a bracelet with a yellow moon and stars motif. Around her waist, she has a striking belt made of chunky interlinked plastic rings in green, yellow, red, and black. Her skirt is adorned with glued heart-shaped patches of varying shades of pink and purple. She wears simple beige cowboy-style boots with slight slouching.

Ronaldini has olive eyes, black hair, a mustache above his lips, and fair skin. He has a black top hat, with the crown's walls resembling the iron holder of an ironing board that houses his rabbit, which is an iron. He has a burgundy-colored bowtie, and his white shirt follows a light blue wavy symmetric line pattern with light blue stars dotted around. Ronaldini also has a crimson-colored U-shaped waistcoat that has white trim and subtle diamond lattice patterns on his sides, and screws for buttons. His violet tailcoat has patterns of the ironing board's legs on his arms, and also has screws for buttons. The lapels are the back of ironing boards that have a violet, grey, and black square pattern cover pad, as well as the tailcoat's inner lining. His decorative shoulder pads are two ironing boards with distinct cover pad designs, his left being green diagonal stripes, and his right is pink overlapping circles. He has a burgundy-colored square-patterned coat that hangs from his back, with a light pink inner lining and white cuff buttons. His violet pants follow a similar pattern of the ironing board legs found on his sides. His shoes are a mix of shades of pink in a square pattern with a white sole.

Jean Loo has pale skin, blue eyes, subtle freckles and semi-black hair with blue frosted tips resembling the bristles of a toilet brush. Jean Loo wears a white hooded jacket and white sweatpants whose texture resembles the porcelain of a toilet. Jean Loo wears a broken plunger beret. Underneath his jacket is a blue shirt resembling wet bathroom tiles. He wears three chains and flexi-hoses around his neck, his largest one being a chain necklace of a flush valve flapper, and attached to that is his microphone, Ballcock. He has blue painted nails, and has somehow managed to fit a whole roll of toilet paper around his wrist, using it as a bracelet. He has another flexi-hose on his pants. His white boots have gold toilet seats decorated on the top.

Jerry is a thin, fair man with messy black hair that has a pen, a lightbulb, a pencil, and rubber bands stuck in it. He has brown eyes and a light stubble, and he wears glasses that have a price tag still on them. He wears a brown shirt that looks like several wooden drawers atop each other, and a beige, wood-like jacket over that. The collar of his shirt looks like a receipt, and he wears a bow over that which resembles a playing card. The lapels of his jacket are a bunch of miscellaneous receipts, and his shoulders have a CD atop each. His jacket has a bunch of miscellaneous buttons randomly strewn across. Attached to the top left is a boutonnière made of paper, on the bottom left is a calculator, and on the bottom right is a notebook with earbuds inside the pages. The tops of his sleeves have pockets shaped like drawers, the left one containing some wire and the right one containing two playing cards and earbuds. Strewn across his sleeves are several rubber bands of various colors, and there are patchwork designs on his elbows that resemble sticker sheets. Around his waist, there is a measuring tape that goes down to the middle of his thigh and some papers. His pants, too, look like they have several wooden drawers with buttons and rubber bands randomly strewn across, and all of those drawers are filled with miscellaneous objects. His socks are blue with white stripes, and he wears brown loafers that, too, have a drawer-like design.

He is tall and slim with fair skin. He has a head of curly, black hair swept over to one side. He has a sharp, rectangular face shape with downturned eyes and pointed black eyebrows. He wears a transparent shower curtain cape draped over his shoulders with metal detailing and a handle on the left side. His shirt has white shower tile detailing with two sections of thin blue tiles in various shades; attached around his neck and hung across his chest is a metal shower caddy holding various bottles. He has a pink loofa resembling a flower attached to the left side of his chest. His trousers are a shiny white acrylic with blue anti-slip mats laid across his thighs and a drain where his belt is. He wears a pair of light blue grip shower slippers and holds a shower head attached to a long cord and stand with his left hand, using it as a microphone.

Keith is an elegant, broad and charming silver fox. He has sharp cheekbones and subtle downturned eyes. He has thick silver hair: eyebrows, an upturned moustache, thick goatee, mutton chops and shoulder length hair that's pushed back and curled inwards at the ends. He wears a large, old-fashioned key hoop around his neck with five keys attached. He wears a well-tailored black suit, with a grand cape instead of a jacket. He wears a collared white shirt with buttoning down the centre, his vest is satin black and has aged-gold, swirling patterns covering the lapel and gold keyhole and key fasteners down the centre. The sleeves reach his wrist and have a small keyhole shaped cuff. He wears tight-fitting white gloves. His ankle cut trousers are the same black material, with a seam down the middle of both legs. He wears black formal shoes with a gold keyhole detail over the front. His cape covers his shoulders and reaches to his knees in the middle; the interior is an aged-gold material with wear around the edges and scratch marks across the centre. Keith holds a large, aged, silver skeleton key with a design resembling his face on the end.

Keyes is a dark-brown-skinned Nigerian woman with a tall, somewhat curvy figure, brown eyes, and thin, well-defined eyebrows. She wears her long black hair in a braided updo with a headband that resembles piano pedals. She wears gold eyeshadow, gold lipstick, and has gold earrings in the shape of treble clefs. She also has piercings at the helix areas of her ears that resemble bass clefs. She wears thick black eyeliner and has silver nail polish. She wears a gold halter dress with a plunge neckline and a necklace in combination that resemble pieces of a piano, with her costume showing tuning pins, base and treble strings, and soundboard of a grand piano. She wears silver bracelets with gold accents that resemble whole notes on a musical staff. The overlapping cape-like layer over her dress is flared out down to her feet and at her left shoulder to resemble the shape of a grand piano. She wears a belt that looks like the keys of a grand piano over top of her costume and shining golden shoes.

Koa has dark brown hair that is shaved on the sides with curls on top, brown eyes and a goatee. He wears a short sleeved jacket that has a large collar that mimics a couch frame with elephant ear leaf patterns on the sleeves and below the arms on the collar. The vest of the jacket is made of cushions with a pattern that features tropical plants. His skirt is made of the same type of wood as the collar of his jacket and is adorned with patterns of the same leaf. There are dollar bills, coins, and receipts sticking out of the top of his skirt. He wears sandals with the same fabric pattern as the vest on his jacket that also feature a back and arms that somewhat resemble a beach lounger. He wears a necklace made of cushion springs that is adorned with items that might be found in couch cushions: keys, coins, and candy in wrappers. He also wears a bracelet that has the design of couch springs.

Kopi is short and soft, with a round, friendly face. She has honey-toned skin and a coffee brown braid that goes just past her shoulders, with a side part fringe and lighter highlights throughout her hair. She has a black coffee machine button panel on top of her head. The shirt she wears has a classic tulip latte art pattern across it, with white mugs on the sleeves, a beige ruffled collar and two rope tassels attached to the back. She wears a rustic brown knee-length apron on top with a crosshatch pattern; it has coffee bean symbols over the chest and two drawstring pockets on the lower half, one of which holds a white tea towel with brown accents. While the apron blocks what she's wearing as bottoms, it looks to resemble a black coffee machine with metal detailing in the shape of a skirt. Her shoes are metal milk jugs with frothed milk around the top.

Kristof is a large and muscly man, with his physical appearance resembling a Viking. His skin has a pink-ish tone, with a large nose, chiseled jaw and a piercing gaze. He has blonde hair that reaches past his shoulders, tied into two braids and a full beard. He wears a black head piece made of treadmill handlebars in the style of a horned Viking helmet, or similar to a Bull. The upper half of his armour consists of a treadmill track in a tank top shape, with a touch pad across the chest and plastic side bars running parallel; he wears a pair of elbow length, fingerless grey gloves with speed adjustment button pads attached to the forearm and wheel tracks running along the side. He wears a V shaped belt made of a dark grey plastic, with a treadmill wheel attached over his crotch. He wears dark, lined leggings with two miniature treadmill belts either side of his hips, spanning the length of his thighs. His boots reach his knees and are also made of treadmill belts, with their own handle bars attached and a metal underside.

Memoria has short black hair that frames her face in a wavy pattern. She is wearing a long black dress that flares out by her knees. She has a lace cape that has many designs on it such as moons, handprints, and frames. The top of the cape appears to have feathers as well as an old fortune teller on her shoulder. She has dark makeup such as eyeshadow and a black lip. Her shoes are mostly hidden by her dress, but appear to have heart shaped pictures or lockets on them. She is holding a robotic dog in her arms whose white and gold color scheme stands out against hers.

Lucinda is a tall, curvy and extravagant woman, her visual appearance and outfit scream luxury with gold and azure blue tones throughout. She is tanned all over and has a soft face with a pointed chin; her eyes are a warm hazel with dark eyeshadow, long lashes, soft blush and champagne highlighter in her inner corners and on her nose. Her hair is a fierce ginger, fading from a warm brown at the crown into a fiery orange with thick waves throughout; her bangs are curled dramatically, with a tall quiff and flicked ends. She wears a mini gold top hat made of stacked gold coins, with gold gemstone details and a large curled golden feather attached to the side. She wears dangle earrings made of three gold stars, with a pearl interior. Her nails are painted gold. Her outfit is very revealing; she wears a thick blue and navy blue choker with gold star and moon patterns wrapped across it, attached to a low hanging halter neck top that barely covers her bust by three straps. She wears detached puffy sleeves over her upper arm, mostly black with blue and gold detailing. She wears a low-waisted pair of black leggings with cut outs over her hip and thigh which are surrounded by gold diamond details. Her shoes are stiletto heels, mostly gold with a large pearl diamond in the centre and over the toe cap. Attached to her back is a 5 section orange cape which reaches past her knees in pentagon shapes, each individual section has gold trim with diamond cut outs down the centre, and a large blue diamond at the bottom with gold triangle trim around the edges.

Luke is a short but buff man with an intense appearance. His features are sharp with a piercing gaze and garnet red hair cut in a square shape with a thick gunslinger moustache. He has a pair of rectangular sunglasses with red rims and yellow lenses, which he wears during battle. The armour he wears on his top is made up of various packaging and microwave equipment; his left arm is covered in food packaging and a black arm brace with a glass turntable attached, which is used as a shield. His right shoulder has a metal armour plate with various ventilation sections throughout, his forearm has a control panel wrapped around it with various wires that connect to his gun. The gun is metal, blocky and heats up when used. Over his chest is a standard, red microwave door with a silver handle, attached to a black chest harness. He has a silver belt with a small cooling fan in the centre and a square, silver gun holster attached, which hangs over the right side of his hip. He wears tight fitting, black trousers that are tucked into a pair of black heeled boots, with a button panel and dial on the front, and glass undersides.

Lux is a person with light skin, short, light blond hair, and eyes with glowing yellow irises and white pupils. Behind their head is a glowing circle of light, resembling a halo, and they often have another circle floating just above their hand acting as a camera, resembling a ring light. They wear a crop top, with the upper portion being a black bar with small, round lightbulbs on top, and the lower portion resembling a lampshade. The sleeves resemble lightbulbs as well. Wrapped around their torso are LED strip lights, and on their waist is a belt resembling light switches. They wear black shorts and leg braces that resemble the arms of balanced-arm lamps. On their feet are silver boots with glowing yellow heels that represent spiral light bulbs and other lightbulbs on the shaft of the boot, with three lights below both. Around their neck they wear a necklace, possibly resembling the pull chain of a lamp or a bendable tripod, and on the middle fingers of both hands they have rings: the left resembling a flashlight and the right resembling a lightbulb.

Lyric is a man with dark eyes, tan skin, and glasses that have frames resembling books. Atop of his head is an opened book with a red and yellow bookmark in it, made to represent hair, specifically resembling long bangs and a ponytail. He has a floating scroll that wraps around him, and a scarf resembling a scroll as well. He wears a red jacket resembling a book with the collar up, the inside resembling newspapers. He floats in the air with a skirt made of papers, resembling a genie tail. Finally, Lyric has at least 5 tattoos: a quill and a bookworm on his left arm, two quills on his abdomen, and a bookmark on his right arm.

Mac has short, messy black hair, reading glasses with the frame being an RGB wheel, fair skin, a tattoo on their right arm which is a motherboard, and on their left arm a green binary code tattoo; both cover the arms. They are wearing a jacket; the cuffs of the sleeves have two surround sound ports and one USB port, and the front of the jacket is an RGB keyboard print. They also have two RGB fans printed on their shirt. The front of their belt has a USB computer port with a surround sound computer port right next to it. Their pants are simple, only having two prints at the middle of the thighs, which are two USB ports. Their pants are pulled up to almost their knees, and they wear black boots where, instead of shoe laces, there's two USBs. They also have a computer mouse that is basically a pet on their left shoulder, resembling an actual mouse. Mac is also in a wheelchair. The backrest has a design resembling a computer screen, the armrests resemble throbbers (loading symbols), and the wheels are black with two rainbow concentric circles near the edges. Their seat is rainbow, and they have a glowing footplate resembling a keyboard with castors attached.

Maggie is a woman with fair skin, a round face, blue eyes, and red, curly hair. Atop of her head is a magnifying glass hat. She wears magnifying glass-shaped glasses, a light blue trench coat with gold accents and magnifying glass buttons, black tights, and light blue boots with golden elements forming a magnifying glass shape on the soles.

Mateo is a small, round-faced young man with shining brown eyes, dark brows, a flat nose, and thin lips. His curly hair is an electric white that is styled in a sideways pile to the left, falling over his forehead. His skin is a warm toffee-color and is mostly obscured by the thick, blanket-esque blue coat he wears draped around his plump form. His low-collared undershirt is a plain white quilt of stitched-cushion texture, and his baggy blue pants are the same. A kilt-like orange blanket with feathery tassels decorates his waist and hangs down to his shins, which are adorned only with a pair of fuzzy blue slippers.

He has a more animated look than anybody else, with a tattoo of 3 flying dollar bills on his left arm. He has 2 large gauntlets around his lower arm, and black fingerless gloves, and a chestplate that looks like a literal treasure "chest". He also has a large sack over his shoulder in which his "Brundles" are held, along with his RNG items. On his head he has a lid-like helmet. He also dons 2 boots, which are thematically matched to his treasure chest look.

Miranda is a short, curvy character with soft facial features including light brown eyes, a button nose, and red lips. Her thick, curly afro features bright orange strands resembling hot wires from a toaster, and she wears Pop-tart and bagel-themed accessories. Her outfit is a babydoll dress with bread-slice sleeves in various toast shades and a metal top featuring heated wire designs and toaster-inspired buttons. The skirt displays a top-view toaster design with four slots and heated wires. She completes the look with silver platform heels featuring carriage switch details. Her guitar uniquely uses a toast slice as the body with heated wire strings, and a triangular golden-yellow head decorated with butter cubes, a dial, butter knife, and carriage switch.

Mitchell has hazel eyes, tumbleweed skin, and has subtle freckles on his face. His hair is golden and coiled, resembling ramen noodles, which is tied back by a piece of farfalle into a low ponytail. Mitchell has a sprinkle of ramen dried garnishings and a fish cake accessory on top of his hair. His shirt has a salmon pattern with black sesame seeds on the trim, meanwhile his cuffs and collar are lettuces (purple and green). His blazer has a lattice crust pattern with blueberry-coloured filling, a pie-shaped chest pocket that has a handkerchief with yellow details and his initial 'M', a lapel as his avocado slices on toasts, and his olives as buttons. He also has a piece of herb garnishing in his outfit's centre (possibly cilantro or thyme). Mitchell's pants are a dark chocolate bar pattern, and his shoes resemble croissants or buns. He also holds rosemary and toast that act as his notepad and pencil.

Monique is a skinny Asian woman with brown eyes, thick groomed, curved eyebrows, a thin nose, and light green hair. Her eyes have epicanthic folds and thick black eyeliner. She wears green eyeshadow, a gold and green barrette in the shape of a United States dollar bill folded into a heart, earrings that are rolls of coins, and a necklace, two bracelets, and a ring of gold, silver, and copper coins. She wears a tube top of green United States dollar bills and wears matching brown leather pants and a brown and black leather jacket. Her pants and leather jacket resemble that of a wallet, with light brown stitching and various pockets. The pockets on her left sleeve jacket have three credit cards slotted neatly into them. She wears green high heels that have imagery from dollar bills as well. She carries a gold tablet with her that has the shape of an angular heart on it, matching the same shape of her barrette.

They are a beast-like individual with shadowy skin, and different types of animal features such as a unicorn head, a lion on its left side, a snake on their right side, and a wolf-like tail at her back. It has nightmarish features such as many different kinds of eyes in its mane, a mouth in their chest, and a different set of teeth below her chest.

Parker is a lanky man with flushed fair skin, adorned entirely in a jumble of board game attire. He wears a pack on his back of several board game boxes and pieces tied to him by string in the fashion of a backpack. Parker's design contains many references to board games: his hat is a pawn from Sorry!. His hair is play money, likely from games like Monopoly. His jacket is the board for Connect 4. The top of his jacket are the flippable pieces from Guess Who?. His shoes resemble the house game pieces from Monopoly. His belt resembles a Yu-Gi-Oh duel disk. His alternate sprite in his second interaction has swim trunks that resemble the mat and spinner arrows from Twister. His tattoos feature the standard four card suits (heart, diamond, spade and club), snakes and ladders, and meeple board game pieces, among other things.

Penelope has honey eyes, black curly hair with a few red and blue squiggles reminiscent of pen squiggles, and fair skin. Her hair also has two hair slides that look like paper clips and a metal pen holder hair tie on top that has a few pens and pencils. She wears a white blazer that appears to be stacked lined paper from spiral notebooks, complete with the holed lapel and ripped paper cuffs with drawn squiggles, which appears to be stapled in the middle. At her arms are colored labels, and on her blazer at the left is a drawn red flower. Her yellow shirt, that has been scribbled on, has scissors for the bowtie and is lined with yellow post-it notes with miscellaneous drawings at the center. Her skirt is yellow lined paper, with one half also scribbled in blue ink, and the other having a pair of googly eyes. She wears black stockings, and her shoes are tape dispensers. She holds various office supplies: stacks of paper, a few pens, post-it notes, and a clipboard.

Phoenicia is a curvy, mahogany-skinned woman with a shaved head and brown eyes. She has simple makeup and multicolored stiletto nails mimicking the color scheme of the phone's UI. She wears a short, form-fitting dress that resembles the user interface of a smartphone, with buttons on her shoulders that resemble the lock button and volume control. There is a rectangular adornment just below the neckline that looks like a front-facing camera. The pattern on the sleeves and bodice mimic the home screen of the player's phone, while the pattern on the skirt resembles a smartphone keyboard. The dress has a belt that resembles the "slide to unlock" interface from old iPhones. She wears an earring shaped like a rotary phone dialer that has a chain that leads to a phone handset ear cuff. She has tattoos on her left leg depicting a fully charged battery, a full bar cellular connection in a heart, and a single bar connection in a broken heart. Her shoes resemble a rotary phone handset.

Prissy is a slim, toffee-skinned woman with deep brown eyes, thick, dark brows, a flattened nose, and full lips. Her hair is an eruption of faux, plastic leaves that suggest the shape of a ponytail, vine-covered bangs dotted with various miniature flowers, and a hair clip of monstera leaves with a sunflower centerpiece and accompanying dragonfly charm. She wears a full-body transparent mesh decorated in ivy leaves, and her chest is covered by an open vest made of green, spongy floral foam that houses a collar of flowers and a small, plastic hummingbird. Her skirt is a curved, white-and-gold vase outlined with an aureate lacquer of cherry-blossom branches, and her platform heels are the same green floral foam as her vest, pierced with a bouquet of decorative flowers resembling a zipper.

Rainey wears a dramatic vinyl hat that has a turntable arm attached. Her dress is sleeveless, with the bodice resembling a record player's speaker accompanied by gold and brown colors, and white buttons. Her dress's neckline is black with sequins, above is a shiny orange color with a slight hint of white. The bottom part of her dress is made up of colorful, vertical stripes mirroring album covers or vinyl sleeves. The hem moreover are stacked vinyl records with colorful labels. Her shoes are brown heels with record embellishments. She also has accessories that include golden bangles on both wrists, dangly golden earrings that have a record garnishment, and underneath her hat is a golden headband with sequins. She has deep brown skin complexion with black, short, and curly hair styled with soft waves that frame her face. She has large, expressive brown eyes that have a subtle black eyeshadow, and a deep red lipstick painted. Her nose is broad and rounded as well.

Rebel is an anthropomorphic duck with yellow skin, a pink mohawk resembling that of a crest, pure black eyes similar to that of Dishy and The Sassy Chap, and a tail similar to that of a real-world duck. They wear orange and black studded boots (with a design resembling duck feet), a black studded halter bra top, a black mini skirt, a black studded belt, and a yellow cropped vest with closed sleeves that make the jacket look like a pair of wings.

Reggie is tall and toned with a flamboyant sense of style. He has hazelnut toned skin, full lips and dark pink irises with pointed upper lashes. He has thick black eyebrows and a triangular Van Dyke beard with a subtle upper-lip moustache. He has thick, dark maroon twist braids with gold hair cuffs attached throughout. His fingernails are painted with a sparkly gold polish. He wears a sheer, red, off the shoulder, long sleeve, twisted crop top with metal gold accents in an 'X' shape across his chest. On both shoulders there is a gold broken-heart symbol with a red-pink heart backing. There are gold accents wrapped behind the heart and a grand swirled piece on his left shoulder resembling two halves of a broken heart. He has gold wrist cuffs on both arms with swirling details and an 'X' emblem at the center. Over his hips is a gold metal piece, resembling two 'thumbs down' shapes with swirling patterns inside. His skirt is asymmetrical, and has an opening over his right leg; it has a pink-red half-broken heart down the center with gold outlining. The rest of the skirt is a dark maroon color with a gold broken heart pattern along the bottom. He wears thigh-high maroon boots.

River's appearance is entirely made of water. She has cerulean skin, sky-blue hair, and a dress that gradients from white foam to a medium blue. She seems to be wearing simple makeup, also in shades of blue that highlight her features. She has long, literally flowing, hair. Her dress resembles a ballgown that goes down past her feet that starts with ruffles around her neck, to a plunging neckline, down to layered ruffles in the skirt that resemble waves of water. There are two sets of water droplets, one more circular and closer to her neck and one made of more ornamental droplet shape, that make up one "necklace".

Rongomaiwhenua is a towering, celestial figure who radiates light. She has a sharp jaw, blinding blue almost white eyes, dark purple lips and a pale yellow symmetrical patterning across her forehead and chin but only one arm visible. Her exterior is made up of rough, dark grey rock with gold cracks throughout. The inside of the geode flows from the top of her head, down her left side to the floor and is made up of a gradient from dark blue, to white, to the jagged purple centre, likely amethyst. Her upper half is dark purple around the edges and fades into a pink centre; she has a large cluster of crystals covering her right shoulder, made up of pointed dark purple points and three heart shaped crystals: one pink, one yellow, one white. She has more pale yellow patterns across her arm, wrist and hand. Over her chest is another purple geode, this one similar to agate with rings of purple shades and yellow accents, with a yellow heart carved in the centre.

His appearance is befitting his title as '18th-century dandy.' He is a pale man with blue eyes and tall, cream-colored hair resembling that of a wig worn by 18th-century men. He has a prominent chin adorned with a single beauty mark or mole on the right side of face. He's adorned with silver expected of the time he emulates, wearing a coat and pantaloons which are each silver with white embroidery meant to resemble dripping wax. His coat has a similar color scheme, but none of that wax pattern. While his undershirt is largely hidden, its frilly sleeves peek out past the sleeves of his coat. He wears grey, shiny shoes with a white bow atop each. His jabot and stockings are also cream-colored, but have a slightly darker tint than his hair.

Shelley is a fit character with hickory skin tone, brown eyes, and brunette hair in a ponytail. She sports an athletic-style outfit with a jacket, sports bra, athletic shorts, flat brim cap, knee-high socks, and high-top athletic shoes. Each piece of her outfit uses a white pattern that mimics the wood grain of a shelf. The brim of her hat has a tiny cactus on it in a pink pot. She wears a letterman jacket with white sleeves, and stripes on the body that have items one would find on a bookshelf. The left side, from top to bottom, has a ship in a bottle, an action figure, a flower in a pot, and a framed photo. The right side, from top to bottom, has a snow globe with a house inside it, two framed photos, an alarm clock, a book, a teapot, and a teacup. Her sports bra is black with white trim that have three trophies in the middle. Her athletic shorts are black with white trim that have books adorning two "shelves". Her socks are white with three black stripes and her shoes are red and white. She has two bandages on her right knee.

He is a relatively skinny man, who has the head of a white (squareish) sink. The drain hole is his mouth, the spout is his nose, the temperature dials are his eyes and the handles are his eyebrows. His hair is represented by a yellow 8-shaped sponge set behind his eyes. His neck is silver piping, and he is wearing an off-white long-sleeve button up shirt. On his chest there is more piping in the shape of a stethoscope. In his breast pocket there is a toothbrush and a tube of toothpaste. His sleeves are rolled up to the elbow, his arms are human and a rosey-beige color. His belt is a bronze/gold pipe with silver piping keeping it attached at the front/center. He is wearing shiny, black, leather pants, with silver nuts above and below his knees. His shoes are a shiny silver with a nut at the top around the ankle, and otherwise a relatively normal shoe shape.

Skylar has fair skin with peach undertones and long, straight pink hair with yellow streaks. She wears pink-tinted glasses similar in appearance to the Dateviators, a pink bra, a miniskirt made of pink, yellow, and white hearts, and white ankle boots. She also wears a cropped white jacket with blue trim, heart-shaped buttons, and yellow glasses-shaped adornments at the lapels and wrists.

Sophia is a tall, curvy and luxurious looking woman. She has a domineering gaze, with dark brown eyes, sharp eyeliner and a dark smoky eye. She wears black lipstick and has pointed, light brown eyebrows. Her hair is a blonde, shoulder-length asymmetrical pixie cut with soft waves and curled ends. She has pointed gold nails.
